lyrics: 2 gAdhipasuthuni vEnTa chanuthsu thATaka goorCHi yajNamunu gApAdina
3 gauthamamuni sathini gathakalushajEsi gajagamana janakapuriki jani shivuni villava virachi pudamithagupathiyai vijayarAghavuDanuchu pEru kOnina
4 dhAsharathi saumithri bharatha shathrugna yuthudavai pANigrahaNa mahOthsavamuthO purambu vEdala sukarambuna bhArgavu garvamaDanchina

5 shrI raghuvara pithruvachanamuna vipinamunaku vEdachani suraripula gElichi munivarula gAchi sugrIvanaku rAjyamunOsagi vibhishaNuni rakshinchi jaladhini dhATi rAvaNuni kOTTi yAvalan sIthanukOni pavanajAthulathO sAkEthapurini abhishithudaina
